description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzVideoURLValidationAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for validating and retrieving embedded URLs from provided video links. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Buzz plugin's API module.

classes.name: BuzzVideoURLValidationAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint that validates video URLs and returns embedded URL information, extending the Endpoint class and implementing ResourceEndpoint interface.
